title: Maamkuzi na Maagano (Theme 2: Michezo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child greets one or many, at the right time, with the right reply, and knows why greetings matter in a game or a meeting.
representations: a chart of greetings for one and many

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child acts greeting a team and the team replies "Hatujambo".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Unawasalimia wanafunzi wengi darasani: "___!"" Kwa nini "Hujambo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa mtu mmoja tunasema Hujambo na Kwaheri. Kwa watu wengi tunasema Hamjambo na Kwa herini.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Asubuhi unamwamkia mwalimu: "___, mwalimu."" Kwa nini "Lala salama" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Asubuhi tunasema Habari za asubuhi. Usiku tunasema Lala salama au Usiku mwema.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Unaondoka na kumwaga mtu mmoja: "___!"" Kwa nini "Hujambo" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Mdogo anamwambia mzee "Shikamoo". Mzee anajibu: "___."" Kwa nini "Shikamoo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mdogo husema Shikamoo kwa heshima, na mzee hujibu Marahaba.

checks.question: Salamu ya "Hujambo" kwa watu wengi ni?
